description: This file defines models for managing scheduled cron jobs, including session targets, wake modes, delivery configurations, schedules, payloads, and the cron job entity itself. It includes enums, structs, and Codable conformance for serialization/deserialization, along with derived properties for additional info like display names and dates.

methods.name: from(_ value: String)
methods.description: Creates a CronCustomSessionTarget from a string, interpreting predefined or session ID formats.

methods.name: parseAtDate(_ value: String) -> Date?
methods.description: Parses a string into a Date object, trying ISO 8601 formats with or without fractional seconds.

methods.name: formatIsoDate(_ date: Date) -> String
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ISO 8601 string without fractional seconds.
